scope: Synthetic four-state CTMC; no laboratory measurements

model.detector: binary state bit; perfect and noninvasive
model.spectral_gap_justification: Dirichlet comparison with independent bit flips at min rate1/50 and sector flips1/1000

design.setting_order: all lag1 records, then all lag2 records; predetermined

scenarios.name: shared_endpoint_pairs
scenarios.chronology: reuse prior pair endpoint as next pair start
scenarios.purpose: Stationary marginals do not validate iid or bounded conditional mean0

scenarios.name: blind_mixing_gap
scenarios.initialization: fixed state0 for each independent replicate
scenarios.chronology: blind gap before every pair, then read start, wait lag, read end
scenarios.purpose: Known uniform reversible gap bound controls whole-pair conditional bias

scenarios.name: independent_stationary_pairs
scenarios.initialization: fresh stationary preparation before every pair
scenarios.purpose: Valid iid baseline with identical per-menu record counts

reported_metrics: total pair evolution plus blind-gap model time
uncorrected versus corrected analysis of identical dependent counts
analysis_constraints: Do not infer the uniform mixing contract from the same unknown data
All detector memory would have to enter the mixed state or have a separate reset bound
The honest no-gap correction may be uninformative; retain it
Simulator uses exact CTMC transition law via matrix exponential, cross-checked by uniformization
